items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: I've heard several people talk about him.

ctx.x: Showboats. Showboats. Showboats. They used to travel from one bayou, one section to another. I remember when Bill Kersan came to New Iberia on a showboat. And I'm trying to think of the name of that boat. And they had, he stayed there, I think it was almost a week. You see. And went out, came in to buy a, to buy the food, to buy a tash. You see. Into buy a tash from a Tuffle out there. They went to buy a tash and he made several shows at New Iberia and St. Martinville, I think, and Franklin, and Patterson. And he…
Yeah. Yeah. Bunk played with it.
